title: Calling the server from a page
summary: A page gets data from the server through a client class. Mark the class with `HTTPClient` and its methods with `GetRequest`, `PostRequest` and the other request annotations. A service gets the client with `Needs` and calls its methods. In JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, C#, F#, Rust, Go, Kotlin, Swift and Java, a client whose Setup gives it no adapter sends its request through the browser to the server of the page, without cookies. This browser transport refuses every other origin. In Ruby the client needs a Setup that gives it an HTTP adapter. Python and Lua cannot use `HTTPClient` (`TY1308`). A request to another host goes through a Setup adapter, and that host must be listed in `tac.outgoing.hosts`.
